scope: 232b563b versus 34bc2b75 official decode, CANN9.1 dav-c220-vec source and compilation audit; no kernel execution

confirmed.below_8192_query_production_changes: Only q4/q1 decode has changed code; official C4 and current-only paths are unchanged. A short total prompt still also runs q4/q1 generation.
confirmed.source_bindings: Three decode publications use the new helper: K/V ordinary, P, K/V pipeline; zero-padding and shared unpack retain the original helper.
confirmed.sdk_semantics: Both helpers SetMaskNorm, use FP32-to-BF16 RINT with strides1,1,4,8, and ResetMask. Explicit mask/repeat overload does not enable count mode or change saturation CTRL48.
confirmed.constant_kv_count_16384_ir: Baseline device IR retains repeat1 Cast in offset+=64 loop with limit16320; candidate device IR folds batching into two Cast calls with unsigned repeat255 and repeat1, no remaining while/255 branch at this fixed-count publication.
confirmed.source_c16_count_boundary: Existing C16 maximal publication is8192=128 repeats; decode maximal publication is16384=255+1 repeats. This proves distinct source instruction grouping only; no helper-level resource measurement is available.

stack_size_record_bytes.meaning: Matches fixed compiler stack budget; does not establish live registers or spill bytes.

confirmed.compile_status: Both exact commit sources compile successfully with original O3/ISA/auto-sync flags.

unsupported_or_unknown.resource_usage_flag: Official --cce-res-usage accepted but explicitly reported unused for this compilation mode.
unsupported_or_unknown.machine_disassembly: Official llvm-objdump reports <not available> at instruction positions; no repeated disassembler attempts.
unsupported_or_unknown.register_spills: Unknown; identical stack record is not proof of identical spills.

unsupported_or_unknown.root_cause_of_30_percent_short_regressio: Not proven by total wall times or source. Decode is the only changed kernel family reachable when all prefill queries stay below8192, hence a justified narrow isolation target.
unsupported_or_unknown.retaining_64k_gain_after_decode_restore: Requires user hardware result; C16 remains byte-identical to the user-reported successful64K version.
